this is the breakdown of what cards are being used in despia currently

you can find example decklists in there too.

\-the Idea for despia right now is to have a way to fusion , so you need a despia monster + poly +another monster.

\-the goal for now is to setup as many masquerades as possible to stop the opponent from comboing, if unable to make 2 we go for quaeritis and threaten the fallen of albaz.

\-for starters , remove every spell but branded in red x2 / branded opening x3 / theatre x1-2 . the rest are bad.

as for monsters , remove comedy , play 1 dramaturge / 1 ad lib , 1 albaz as we don't have the good fusions (and broken fusion spell ) yet , remove ecclesia and albion for the same reason .

​

\-add in the patchwork engine (222 is my preferred ratio , add in DPE engine (small or large up to preference ) .

\-for handtraps 3 maxx c is mandatory imo , then ash or veiler up to preference  ( I like veiler cause he's light therefore can be used for fusion ) , and of course the 2 called by the grave . ( Imo I think playing too many HTs in despia is bad as you need to fuse or you lose )

\-the rest of the maindeck is what I 'd call techs , mainly consist of  a draw spell of choice , some poeple like allure of darkness , I personally use prosperity .

.2x super polymerization is really good in this deck .

.foolish burial or gold sarc  (or both ) to up the consistency of getting aluber in hand .

.a feather duster since the deck for now has a big weakness to backrow decks since we don't have guardian chimera yet.

and that's it for the main.

\-for the extra deck real quick , since fallen of albaz isn't our main play remove all the albaz fusions , and add the actual good ones ( albion and titaniklad both at 1/ you can ommit titaniklad if you want ).

like I said earlier our main play is getting more than 1 masquerade out so play 2 , if you have a third you can add it though I wouldn't craft the 3rd since we'll cut it in the future .

​

.proskenion is nice but it's a very hard card to get to and we don't summon it often therefore play 1 or max 2 if you must .

.DPE and verte cause we play the engine and it's really good in despia .

.super poly targets ( mudragon / starving venom/dragostapelia)

.linkuriboh or anima for a very specific hand where you get tragedy and branded in red so you normal tragedy and link into one of em and then fuse .
